announcements.text: M1 Support Services L.P., Denton, Texas, was awarded a firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract to provide initial entry rotary-wing training for 800 to 1,500 Army pilots annually using a contractor-owned, contractor-operated solution for commercially available services and equipment at Fort Rucker, Alabama. Bids were solicited via the internet with 11 received. Work will be performed at Fort Rucker, Alabama, and funding will be determined with each task order. This action has a combined cumulative total face value of $10,000,000,000 with an estimated completion date of Aug. 12, 2052. Army Contracting Command, Redstone Arsenal, Alabama, is the procuring contracting activity (W9124P-26-D-A004). (Awarded Aug. 13, 2026).

extracted.description: Initial entry rotary-wing training for 800 to 1,500 Army pilots annually, contractor-owned/contractor-operated, at Fort Rucker, Alabama

announcements.text: The Boeing Co., Tukwila, Washington, has been awarded a maximum $75,000,000 modification P00187 to previously awarded contract (FA8625-16-C-6599) for the procurement of initial spare parts for two, fully mission capable, VC-25B aircraft. announcements.text: Rolls-Royce Corp., Indianapolis, Indiana, is awarded a $48,149,237 firm-fixed-price modification to a previously awarded contract (N00024-25-C-2405) for the production of spares in support of the Ship to Shore Connector, Landing Craft, Air Cushion (LCAC 100) craft program. Said spares include fiscal 2025 base installation and checkout spares; fiscal 2025 base fleet spares; fiscal 2026 spares; and six spare MT7 Turboshaft Engines with ancillary parts and installation kits. Work will be performed in Indianapolis, Indiana, and is expected to be completed by December 2029. This contract is awarded with funding from the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (Public Law 119-21) and directly supports the national effort to revitalize and rebuild American shipbuilding. One Big Beautiful Bill Act funds in the amount of $48,149,237 will be obligated at time of award and will not expire at the end of the current fiscal year. Naval Sea Systems Command, Washington, D.C., is the contracting activity.
